detail.command: npm run typecheck && echo TYPECHECK_OK; npx vitest run > vitest-run.log 2>&1 && echo VITEST_OK || echo VITEST_FAIL; grep -E 'Test Files|Tests ' vitest-run.log; rm -f vitest-run.log; npm run build > build.log 2>&1 && echo BUILD_OK || echo BUILD_FAIL; rm -f build.log; echo '=== LONG LINES (src >200) ==='; awk 'length>200 {print FILENAME ":" FNR " len=" length}' $(git ls-files src)
